A PERSON WHO PERFORMS MEDICAL TRANSCRIPTION IS CALLED A MEDICAL TRANSCRIPTIONIST OR AN MT FOR SHORT. A MEDICAL TRANSCRIPTIONIST CAN ALSO BE CALLED A MEDICAL LANGUAGE SPECIALIST OR MLS. A PERSON WHO PERFORMS MEDICAL TRANSCRIPTION IS CALLED A MEDICAL TRANSCRIPTIONIST OR AN MT FOR SHORT. A MEDICAL TRANSCRIPTIONIST CAN ALSO BE CALLED A MEDICAL LANGUAGE SPECIALIST OR MLS.
